cross_verification.note_en: Directly browsed the official DGME (Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería) 'Visa de ingreso al país' page (mint.gob.ni/migracion/tramites/visa-de-ingreso-al-pais/) and read its full Category C ('visa consultada') requirements table: passport copy (min. 6 months validity), visa request letter, criminal-record certificate, and a notarized support/maintenance commitment. This official checklist does not itemize a photograph as a required document at all, let alone specify size/background/head-height, so no photo-spec fields could be verified for ni-visa from this source.
